description: mcp-hub hooks. SessionStart injects the /mcp router (~3.1KB). PostToolUse (Write|Edit) scans the edited source file in an MCP project and emits one <mcp-hub-drift> advisory citing the owning skill for v1-contamination, instanceof on an SDK error class, or a missing docs/mcp-decisions.md (advisory only, never blocks). SessionEnd removes this session's dedupe scratch file from os.tmpdir(). All run on Node.js (cross-platform: Windows, macOS, Linux); stdlib only, no external dependency.
